name: QASPER: A Dataset of Question Answering on Scientific Research Papers
description: QASPER is a question answering dataset over full-text scientific research papers in NLP and machine learning. Sourced from Open Access papers on arXiv and verified across 1,585 papers, questions were written by NLP practitioners seeking information after reading abstracts, and answers were curated by human annotators reading full papers with supporting evidence spans.
